gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-ovo: Electroharmonix splits every word into separate letters with gaps you can't miss, its round forms open-handed and loud. Ovo then settles in beneath, its thins barely lighter than its thicks, so paragraphs move at a gentle, unhurried pace.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-halant: Halant reads with a traditional, authoritative air, its thick-thin shift faint but real and its terminals flaring outward like tongs. Ethnocentric races ahead, wide-tracked and aggressive, leaving Halant looking like the elder.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa reads classic and editorial, its words looking sturdy and large. Against Ethnocentric, fast and aggressive with short ascenders above big bowls, the counters spilling into surrounding space become the pairing's best trick.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-montagu-slab: Ethnocentric pushes its letters far apart, fast and aggressive. Montagu Slab brings robust downstrokes and slender turns, and its sizable x-height lets the body run modest in size on screen.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-ovo: Ovo keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, with spacious gaps at every curve terminal. Ethnocentric brings speed, Ovo classic authority, and the tension is the draw.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, with a generous entry into the e's eye. Fauna One lets Existence stay industrial and modern, its wide porthole counters free to carry the headline.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, with big counters and open-mouthed curves. Existence does constant stroke weight best, all industrial plainness, while Glegoo does the generous, open lettering that carries sentences.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-hanuman: Industrial is the first word for Existence, whose horizontals match its verticals in thickness. Hanuman supplies the refinement, a high-waisted lowercase with wide-set terminals on s, set against all that industrial sameness.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-noticia-text: Modern and industrial, Existence keeps stems and arcs in lockstep, while Noticia Text gives each curved letter a big visible entrance. Existence is at home in large, brief lines.
gen-dafont-existence-gf-pridi: Pridi lets its small letters stand proud, almost capital-sized, with generous space between curve ends and the stem. And Existence, its stroke weight never changing, gives those proud letters an industrial headline to stand under.
